complete_pair_palette_control.completeness_argument: A facet of P_t-P_u exposes a sum of two faces with total affine span dimension2. If one exposed face has dimension2, its normal is a face normal of one owner. Otherwise both exposed faces are edges with independent directions, and the facet normal is their cross product. These actual edges, both exact owner frames, all face normals and every edge cross product were enumerated; zero products excluded exactly. The retained normals are precisely candidates exposing a two-dimensional sum face for at least one pair. Hence every pair-difference-body facet direction is retained.
complete_pair_palette_control.scope: Two fixed proper antiprism frames only; no arbitrary-frame recognition or packing optimum claim.

square_source_control.tail_rule: Same level: four unit axial words flip parity and are actual contacts. Every remaining nonzero planar word has length at least sqrt(2)*d>2R. Other levels have disjoint full vertical interval interiors; vertical unit steps flip parity and match complete rings. Therefore every integer word is valid.
square_source_control.finite_boundary_rule: Centered nx-by-ny-by-nz complete product block has exact axis extents ((nx-1)*d+2R,(ny-1)*d+2R,nz*H). Each extremum is attained by a literal canonical owner vertex.
square_source_control.source_attribution: PingYou Ltd axial product transfer; no first-discovery claim for the infinite product. AP8 exact square-product source retained as the control.

construction.source_proof:
FORCED CAP-ROW EXCHANGE TRANSFER

Transfer the derived AP6 operation, not its numerical translation. The
3-by-3-by-4 parent is the exact two-frame square source for AP4 or AP12.
Choose one middle row in a complete layer, retain its three frames, shift
it by a common q, and append the alternating endpoint owner. Its four
coordinates are (-1,0,1,2)*d+q. Every host wall gives one inequality in q;
intersect them to obtain the full allowed interval, then test all actual
pair facets and the common initial/final rows. No angle is a variable.

At the half-row anchor q=-d/2, same-row contacts are inherited. Adjacent
unchanged rows have y-offset ±d and x-offset (n+1/2)d. Only n=-1,0 can be
close: all remaining offsets have |x|>=3d/2>2R. Rows at distance two or
more have |y|>=2d>2R. The eight ordered near pairs (both source frames,
both y signs, n=-1,0 with target type=source+n+1 mod2) are checked against
the complete exact difference-body palette. AP4's enclosing-circle
estimate is insufficient, so this literal pair test is essential.

The four independent layer choices share one fixed vertical phase H/2.
All cross-layer pairs retain full-H separation. This transfer tests only
the two actual axial row directions and the four existing layers of this
source block, with full wall-derived translation intervals. A missing
interval or incompatible pair is a retained control, not a global bound.

The successful retained completion moves the two x-directed middle rows at levels zero and one. The lower two layers remain unchanged. The exact middle-row interval is a singleton; the upper cap uses q=-d/2. This gives38 owners, with a literal37-owner deletion. All other tested row intervals and failures remain in ROW_WALL_CLOSURES.json.
